manual.maidconstruction.page1:
[1 - Blueprint]

Hold it and right-click two corners to box the area.

Sneak-right-click a block to clear the pick.
manual.maidconstruction.page2:
[2 - Origin]

Right-click a block: sets the origin.
Right-click air: turns 90 degrees.
Sneak-right-click air: the blueprint panel (preview, rotate, mirror, clear, import/export, 'let maids build this').
manual.maidconstruction.page3:
[3 - Hand it over]

Put the blueprint in her main hand, off hand or bag - all three work.
Set her task to 'Blueprint Builder'. She then goes off to build.
manual.maidconstruction.page4:
[4 - Study mode]

Set her task to 'Study mode', then craft in front of her.

She learns it into her study pool; one product can hold many recipes.
manual.maidconstruction.page5:
[5 - Industry]

Set her task to 'Industry' (placing an order switches her there too).

She fetches materials, crafts from the pool, and puts the results in her bag. If she cannot, she says so.
manual.maidconstruction.page6:
[6 - Study pool]

Hold a stick and sneak-right-click your own maid.

Search, switch recipes, forget one, or place an order.
manual.maidconstruction.page7:
[7 - Her materials]

She looks in this order:
1 nearby chests
2 her wireless terminal (needs an ME network)
3 the container a binding book points at

Then her own bag.
manual.maidconstruction.page8:
[8 - Building]

She walks outside the structure first, then places block by block.

She never buries herself in it.
manual.maidconstruction.page9:
[9 - Progress bar]

The bar names the build and how many blocks are left.
The line under it is what she is doing: fetching, walking to her spot, building.

Other maids nearby add a line.
manual.maidconstruction.page10:
[10 - Her speed]

Base 5 blocks a second.
+1 per 5 favor points, capped at 20 blocks a tick (400 a second).
manual.maidconstruction.page11:
[11 - She is stuck]

Look at the line under the bar:

Fetching = no materials, or the wireless terminal is offline
Walking = she is heading outside
manual.maidconstruction.page12:
[When unsure]

Open logs/latest.log and search for [蓝图施工].

Every 30s she logs one line: state, progress, spot, fetch target. Paste it.
manual.maidconstruction.page13:
[13 - Blueprint Terminal]

Craft: glass pane on top, "redstone - blueprint - redstone" in the middle, obsidian below.

Right-click air to open the terminal home: where the command post is, which blueprint it hosts, which step it is at, and what each maid is doing (idle / standing by / building).

"Library" in the footer: every blueprint as a 3D thumbnail - open one to see its materials, take it into your hand, or project it onto a command post.

The folder is rescanned every five seconds.
manual.maidconstruction.page14:
[14 - Command Post]

Craft: anvil on top, "redstone - blueprint - redstone" in the middle, obsidian below.

Right-click it with the Blueprint Terminal to bind (sneak = unbind). Right-click empty-handed to open its screen.

Place a projection: Library -> open one -> "Project" -> set the position and facing back in the world (right-click to pick, left/right rotate, up/down mirror, E confirm, Q cancel).

Once the projection is placed and maids are assigned, press "Start building" on the terminal home or the post screen. When it is done the post is marked "Done" and she goes back to standing by.

Cancel the projection to cancel the job; breaking the post does the same.
manual.maidconstruction.page15:
[15 - Recording]

Fill in a name at the bottom of the library and hit "Record".

Right-click two blocks to box the area; arrow keys nudge (left X+1, right Z+1, up Y+1, down Y-1; Ctrl switches to the min corner, Shift reverses); E finishes, R resets, Q cancels.

No flying and no wall-passing while recording.

Finishing writes the structure straight into the maidconstruction/blueprints folder as a file.
